achievements.name: Defeat Automalein
achievements.description: Win against Automa at exactly automalein difficulty. A tied score counts as a human win.

achievements.description: Win against Automa at exactly automa difficulty. A tied score counts as a human win.

achievements.name: Full Deployment
achievements.description: Finish with all 18 standard building pieces simultaneously deployed: 8 mines, 4 trading stations, 3 research labs, the institute and both academies. Excludes Lost Planet, artifacts, Gaiaformers and space stations. No win required.

achievements.name: Federation Builder
achievements.description: Complete at least four federation formations in one game (extensions of the growing federation for Ivits). Token rewards and rescores do not count. No win required.

achievements.name: Every World: Base Game
achievements.description: Finish a base game with main-owned colonies on all seven ordinary planet types, Gaia and the Lost Planet. Gaiaformers and Lantids shared mines do not count. No win required.

achievements.name: Every World: Lost Fleet
achievements.description: Finish a Lost Fleet game with main-owned colonies on all seven ordinary types, Gaia, Lost Planet, Asteroid and Protoplanet. Artifacts, Gaiaformers and Lantids shared mines do not count. No win required.

achievements.name: Growing Federation
achievements.description: As Ivits, complete at least four formation milestones of your growing federation in one game. No win required.

achievements.name: Shared Civilization
achievements.description: As Lantids, finish with at least six additional mines on opponents' colonies. No win required.

achievements.name: Balanced Research
achievements.description: As Bescods, finish at level 3 or higher on all six research tracks. No win required.
